integrity: Proof gives exact finite-noise signs and collision asymptotics; independent symbolic and arbitrary-precision comparisons are supplementary, not infinite proof. No independent external mathematical audit is asserted.
scientific_limitations: Exactly three symmetric distinct nodes; symmetric non-point integration distribution; independent homoscedastic Gaussian noise; nondegenerate normalized Gaussian scale-mixture covariance with finite first and second mixing moments. Positivity, not accuracy or optimal site design. The collision limits fail to apply to rougher mixing laws without the second moment. Publication priority remains conditional on accessible literature.
title: A universal quadratic noise threshold for colliding three-node kernel quadrature
